memory_method: vm_stat free + inactive + speculative pages; reclaimable-memory estimate
policy: normal pressure and 1 GiB headroom for already resident same digest; otherwise max(8 GiB, model file + 2 GiB)
rationale: Do not count already resident weights twice; unloaded estimates reserve file weights plus cache/runtime allowance.
policy_owner: private task supervisor operational launch policy; not model vendor minimum requirements
